title: Tactus-examples: Add real trainable Model examples + specs
description:
# Tactus-examples: Add real trainable Model examples + specs

## Seed Findings

- Existing: ../Tactus-examples/02-classification/03-model-primitive-sentiment.tac
  - Mock backend example is fine (CI-safe), but does not demonstrate training/registry/evaluation.
- Chapter README claims examples run in mock mode and real mode; we need at least one concrete registry-backed, trainable ML example to fulfill that promise.

## Deliverables

- Add at least one registry-backed trainable ML example:
  - Naive Bayes IMDB: train + evaluate + procedure logic branching + deterministic mocks + specs
- Optional but preferred: add second model example:
  - Hugging Face Sequence Classifier IMDB: train + evaluate + procedure + deterministic mocks + specs
- Ensure editorial quality per EDITORIAL.md:
  - runnable
  - CI-safe via mocks
  - clear narrative + breakdown
  - real-mode instructions for training/eval

## Spec Requirements

- Specs must assert meaningful logic (for example: if model says positive -> decision=yes; if negative -> decision=no; if low confidence -> decision=review).
- Provide deterministic mock configuration so CI never needs external model calls.

## Acceptance

- New example(s) exist with deterministic mock-mode specs passing in CI.
- README instructions cover: installing extras, training, evaluating, and running procedure against registry-backed model.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Added trainable registry-backed model examples (Naive Bayes + HF sequence classifier) with deterministic mocks/specs and updated chapter docs in Tactus-examples; pushed feature branch.
custom.beads_notes:
## Audit Notes (2026-02-14)

- Model primitive coverage today is only mocked:
  - ../Tactus-examples/02-classification/03-model-primitive-sentiment.tac
  - ../Tactus-examples/02-classification/README.md mentions mock mode + real mode but we do not yet have a registry-backed, trainable model example.

## Update Requirements (Concrete)

- Add a registry-backed, trainable example that demonstrates the full loop:
  - Define Model with training = { data = { source = \"hf\", name = \"imdb\", ... }, candidates = { ... } }
  - Provide a Procedure that *branches on the model output* (so specs can assert meaningful behavior: yes/no/review).
  - Provide Specs that:
    - pass deterministically in --mock mode (CI)
    - assert at least one positive and one negative case
  - Provide docs in the chapter README:
    - how to install extras (tactus[ml] and/or tactus[hf])
    - how to train and evaluate for real
    - how to run the procedure after training

## Open Decisions (Capture Later in Canon)

- Where to place trainable model examples in this repo:
  - Option: keep in 02-classification (sentiment is classification) and add a new example next to the mocked one.
  - Option: create a dedicated \"Models\" chapter (cleaner long-term).

## Doc Consistency Issue (Non-Model, but discovered during audit)

- ../Tactus-examples/README-INGESTION.md describes a frontmatter-based ingestion design and an examples/ folder taxonomy that do not match current reality.
  - Current reality (as implemented in ../Tactus-web/scripts/ingest-examples.js): ingestion reads chapter README.md + .tac files under numbered chapter directories (01-*, 02-*, etc.), with no frontmatter.
- This mismatch risks confusing contributors and breaking future updates. Recommend fixing as part of the examples/doc program while we are already touching docs.

## Outline (Draft v0)

Goal: add a trainable ML model example that still passes CI in mocked mode.

### Placement

Recommended: keep under classification:
- ../Tactus-examples/02-classification/
  - add a new example file next to 03-model-primitive-sentiment.tac
  - update ../Tactus-examples/02-classification/README.md to describe it

### Example 1: IMDB sentiment with registry-backed Naive Bayes

File requirements:
- Single .tac file that includes:
  - Model "imdb_nb" { type="registry", training={...} }
  - Procedure with branching logic (decision yes/no/review)
  - Mocks { imdb_nb = { conditional = ... } }
  - Specification with at least:
    - positive -> decision=yes
    - negative -> decision=no
    - low confidence -> decision=review
- Top-of-file instructions:
  - install extras: pip install tactus[ml]
  - train: tactus train ... --model imdb_nb
  - evaluate: tactus models evaluate ... --model imdb_nb
  - test mocked: tactus test ... --mock
  - test real: tactus test ... (after training)

Source to adapt:
- Tactus repo: examples/47-model-naive-bayes-train.tac

### Example 2 (optional): Compare NB vs HF sequence classifier

- Add a second file that demonstrates multiple candidates + evaluation.
- Keep specs focused on procedure branching via mocks (CI-safe).
- Document the real train/eval steps as optional.

Source to adapt:
- Tactus repo: examples/49-model-compare-train.tac

### Doc cleanup (discovered)

- Fix or remove misleading guidance in ../Tactus-examples/README-INGESTION.md to match current ingestion reality.
